document.name: Master Circular on Protection of Policyholders' Interests, 2024

rules.name: Delayed Claim Interest
rules.description: Interest is payable at the applicable bank rate plus 2 percentage points for delayed claim settlement, according to the prescribed conditions.

rules.name: Health Reimbursement Settlement
rules.description: Non-cashless health claims must be settled within the prescribed 15-day period.

rules.name: Grievance Resolution
rules.description: The insurer must acknowledge the grievance immediately and resolve it within 14 days.

rules.name: Ombudsman Award Compliance
rules.description: Applicable Ombudsman award compliance requirements must be followed.
